whenToUse: Ranked lists such as a play queue, notification channels or release tasks, put in order by a grip
Tile grids such as a media library, where cards change places across rows and columns
Grouped options and menus reordered in place, such as product variants or sidebar menu entries

whenNotToUse.when: Cards that move between several status columns on one board
Ranked table rows that keep several columns of values lined up
A whole page layout of sidebar, top bar and content area around the list

agentNotes: Drag listeners sit on `SortableItemHandle` only, so a `SortableItem` rendered without one cannot be dragged
Passing `onMove` skips the built-in reorder, so neither `onValueChange` nor `onValueCommit` fires on drop
The drag preview clones the child of `Sortable` whose `value` matches the dragged item, so a wrapper around `SortableItem` needs that `value` too
